articles.title: FAQ
articles.contents:
When are we getting married?
October 24th, 2026
Time until the wedding:



:::
Where is the wedding going to be?
The ceremony will be at the church Sacré-Coeur at 381 Sherbourne St, Toronto, ON M4X 1K4, Canada.
:::
When is the RSVP deadline?
Please RSVP by August 14th, 2026 to help us finalize the guest count. Please understand that RSVPs beyond this date cannot be accommodated.
:::
I don’t speak french and I’m not catholic can I still attend the ceremony?
The wedding mass will take place in a french catholic church. You do not need to be a francophone or a practicing catholic to attend. We simply ask that you come witness our union. You may participate to the best of your ability if you’re confirmed in the church. Otherwise you are welcome to attend and respect this important tradition. We will provide guidance for the mass parts, and trilingual elements will be included.
:::
Can I take photos or videos during the ceremony?
No. We ask that all of our guests power off their devices and keep them out of view during the ceremony in the church. This will help our professional team of photographers to achieve the nicest unobstructed views of the ceremony. This will also allow you to enjoy the moment in your memories alongside of us.
:::
Can I bring my beautiful children?
As much as we’d love to share our evening with your kiddos, we will be keeping this celebration to adults only. Thank you for understanding.
:::
What time should we arrive?
Please be seated in the church by 2:15pm. We will have an organist playing music, and a ring warming tradition we wish to have you join in on before the ceremony begins.
:::
Where should I park?
Please see the Schedule tab for parking information. the church provides some parking, there is on street parking, and the arts and letters club is only a short 5 minute uber or leisurely 15 minutes walk!
:::
What should I wear?
Dress code is formal. Elegant and chic attire; think suits, full length dresses, dress shoes, heels or dressy flats. Please enjoy the opportunity to dress up and wear your nicest outfit!
:::
How will we get to the reception after the mass?
The mass should end approximately around 3:30pm, you will then have two hours to make your way to the reception at the arts and letter club. Bring a change of shoes and walk over, or take a short (5 minute) uber ride, or drive over if you drove to the church (do I hear carpool?). Enjoy the time!
:::
I haven’t been to Toronto before is it safe to walk around?
Toronto is extremely safe! In late fall it might be a little chilly, so make sure to dress for the weather and bring an outdoor layer. The area outside of the church can have a mixed crowd, specially at Allan’s gardens. Stay aware and in a group and you shouldn’t need to worry! Closer to the reception space is the notorious Sankofa square, lots of lights, people, and things to see.
Fun fact: Monique worked at the Toronto Metropolitan University for a year after her undergrad!
:::
whom should I contact with additional questions?
moniqueandalejandro [ @ ] gmail [.com]
:::
Who designed and put together this beautiful website?
Monique put together this website, with thousands of questions for Alejandro’s preferences. She would like to give a shoutout to Leslie Zhen for the template he provided!

articles.title: Wedding Party
articles.contents:
Here is our chance to highlight some of the most important people in our lives. These people have been there through tough times and great times. As we highlight these friends we ask you, if you see them around, to thank them for being such an important part of the pathes that have lead us here today.
Dear wedding party, an innumerably and indissoluble Thank You, Gracias, Merci <3

Luna Muñoz Valencia
Hermana of Honour



Esta experiencia es difícil de explicar porque no encuentro palabras suficientes para
describir todo lo que me hace sentir. Hemos sido cómplices, mejores amigos y compañeros
de vida desde siempre. Al verte hoy aquí, a punto de casarte, siento una mezcla de
nostalgia, emoción y felicidad. Me emociona ver todo lo que hemos crecido y la hermosa
persona en la que te has convertido.
Hoy mi mejor amigo, mi héroe, mi hermano se casa con una gran mujer, una persona a la
que admiro y quiero mucho. Verte feliz a su lado me llena de alegría, porque sé que has
encontrado a alguien con quien compartir todo lo bueno que llevas dentro.
Siempre hemos sido los dos contra el mundo, y sé que eso nunca cambiará. En mí siempre
encontrarás apoyo, amor, admiración y respeto. Eres un hombre con un corazón enorme,
generoso, noble y lleno de cosas buenas para ofrecer. Estoy convencida de que esta
relación es fuerte, los dos son personas maravillosas, merecedoras uno del otro
Hoy es un día muy especial. Hoy es su día. El día en que nos hacen testigos de su amor, de
su unión y del comienzo de una nueva etapa juntos. Gracias por darme la alegría y el
privilegio de ser tu hermana. Es algo que me llena de orgullo y que me ha dado fuerza y
seguridad durante toda mi vida.
Felicidades a los dos. Que nunca les falten motivos para sonreír, para elegirse cada día y
para seguir caminando juntos de la mano.
Escribiendo esto con el corazón en las manos, atentamente
-Tu hermana
:::

























Prince Poirier
Homme of Honour



Prince has known Monique since Grade 4! As kids they bonded over Beanie Babies and singing 60s pop songs. They’ve been friends for over 20 years. Prince likes horror movies and dancing until he passes out.
:::


Gee Peeva
Bridesmate



I met Monique on the first day of grade 10, she was the first person to talk to me in school as a new student when I knew no one. I didn’t realize that our paths crossing that day would result in over 17 years of lore. Monique has always been an incredibly inspiring, kind hearted, and hilarious, brilliant mind for as long as I’ve known her. She always encouraged me to be brave and reach for my goals, from teaching me to play bass in music class when I was 16 to making me introduce myself to a band when I was 22, that I now work my dream job for. We witnessed each other change and persevere and chase our dreams. I couldn’t be more proud of who she is and I’m honoured to still be a part of her journey to this day. I’m so grateful to know you and to call you my precious friend.
Once you share a cookie you know it’s true!!! ❤️
:::


Kimberly Wong
Bridesmate



Here’s proof that chaos is the best kind of friendship!
KimoniqueCowbueingyZeraffephantOnASkateboardWithWings forever!
:::


Leslie Zhen
Bridesmate



Leslie met Monique in school in 2020. We were in a zoom chat for a class and she figured out the code for the stats question sooooooooo fast. I like to think that she’s part of the reason why I now know how to add error bars on plots. Since then, we’ve shared many snack filled adventures, heists, and plenty of mischief. I am grateful for our friendship and so happy to celebrate this exciting chapter of your life.

articles.title: Schedule
articles.contents:
Hotel Block
We recommend staying at the very conveniently located Chelsea hotel. Please use the following link to book your stay to enjoy the courtesy rate. The preferred rate is available until September 25th, 2026.
 Chelsea link - click here 

Parking for the Ceremony
If you are choosing to drive to the ceremony, the church Sacré-Coeur offers a small parking lot just east off of Sherbourne. If this lot is full, paid street parking is available along Sherbourne and Carlton. Please make sure you read the parking signs carefully and adhere to any local traffic laws.
We ask that if you park in the church parking lot that you do not leave your car there after the ceremony.

Parking for the Reception
If you are driving to the reception from the ceremony, the Arts and letters club does not offer parking, but there is a  Impark lot 21     parking garage  , Click N Park nearby, and Chelse hotel parking . Please note that we do not endorse these facilities or have any affiliations; these are simply suggestions. Please use your own wisdom and do what you think is best for you.

Day of Schedule
Please arrive at the ceremony by 2:15pm 
at la Paroisse du Sacré-Coeur,  381 Sherbourne St, Toronto, ON M4X 1K4, Canada . The ceremony will start promptly at 2:30pm. We understand that Toronto has notoriously bad traffic, please plan accordingly.The ceremony will be preceeded by a welcome music from  Manuel Arango Perez  an organist from Montreal, who will be playing from 2:00pm.
Reception:
Cocktail hour will start 15 minutes after the end of the ceremony. Our guests are welcome to make their way over to the  Arts and Letters club  at their leisure, feel free to be a tourist or wander around the neighbourhood (we recommend staying on or west of Yonge street). We ask that you are back at the reception by 5:30pm. The reception will end at midnight.
We ask that if you plan to enjoy any drinks that you please make the necessary arrangements to avoid driving.

articles.title: My Adventure Buddy
articles.contents:
How did you two meet?
Alejandro: We ended up playing on the same soccer team by chance. And we started talking during the social events of the team and then we really enjoyed each other’s company to the point that we planned a trip to new york, shortly after we met. The rest is history.Monique: I moved to Pittsburgh ‘after’ COVID in Spring 2021, in doing so I was trying to meet new people and make friends; I joined two different soccer teams. The second team was the friendlier of the two, we ended up all hanging after our games. Alejandro and I started talking and discovered that we shared a love of road trips. And that’s where it all started. Nearly two years of friendship and adventures later, we chose to start our romantic relationship together, and here we are!

How did the proposal happen?
Alejandro: It happened during a trip because that’s what we like to do together.
I planned a surprise vacation to a special location for the two of us. I chose the place because it has both a beach element and a little chapel that looked very cute that I thought she would like. On the day of we woke up and I was very insistent on going to this beach and struggling to find reasons to go to the beach without raising suspicion. It was a little bit more walking than I thought once we got there. As we were approaching the chapel, I knew my sister was nearby and when we were in her camera’s range, and front of the chapel’s stairs, a fisherman caught a giant Octopus! Monique was very distracted by the Octopus, meanwhile I am trying to regain her attention and struggling to remember my speech. I started telling Monique that I love her a lot, that I really like her and that I have a very important question. And right before I said anything she asked, woah, what’s going on. And then I got down on one knee and taking Monique’s hand and asked her if she wanted to marry me. We both got emotional and…she said yes!
Got up gave her a big hug and told her everything was being recorded.
Monique: On day 3 of a surprise birthday trip to Portugal Alejandro wanted to go explore a beautiful beach just south of Porto. It was a little chilly and still 8am so I was a little confused why we would rush to the beach before grabbing at least a little picnic. We arrived at a sleepy beach with gorgeous sand and rocks on the Atlantic ocean. Just off in the distance there happened to be a chapel, and I enthusiastically said that I would like to go see it! Upon approaching the chapel Alejandro got more nervous, and me more concerned for the very nervous Alejandro. Until he suddenly stopped. Right in front of the steps of the chapel on the rock, he asked me to marry him and I said yes! ( I hadn’t noticed that he stopped because a fisherman had just pulled AN ENTIRE OCTOPUS OUT OF THE OCEAN, and that was my first time seeing an entire live Octopus?!!).

Who asked whom out first?
Alejandro: She asked me out first. We were in Toronto, and we wanted to go out to eat at Pai’s. We sat at the bar and we started talking very honestly to each other. And next thing I remember is her saying that the ball was in my court. I wanted to make sure we knew what were signing up for, and it went way better than I thought. Look at us now!MT: I’m not entirely sure. Looking back it’s hard to tell when our ‘first date’ really was.

What is our favorite trait about your partner?
Alejandro: I really like how intentional and thoughtful you are about everything you do and say.
Monique: He’s my kind of weird! More earnestly, he’s incredibly thoughtful of, and committed to, the people he loves.

Name one quirky trait/memory about your partner.
Alejandro: I think I have learned to recognize how she reacts to some of her pet peeves. I can now see those subtle reactions and that means a lot to me. It happens in many aspects of our relationship and lives, but it especially comes in handy when playing volleyball together!
Monique: He’s goofy…lol…There are so many memories, across so many continents. I think my favourite memory is of the feeling of coming home from work and spending a cozy evening together. A more specific memory is of driving home from a roadtrip at midnight still a few hours to go while blasting the radio singing our hearts out to Celine Dion on our roadtrip playlist.

What is our favorite travel memory together?
Alejo: We went to this beach in the outer banks, and we wanted to go stargazing. We drove there, and it was quiet, we were the only ones there. We just laid down on the beach being amazed by how beautiful the sky looked.
Monique: That time we never actually made it to inca inca beach in Colombia. In short, we spent an afternoon on a sailboat cruise, and got soaking wet from the rainstorm that had suddenly arrived; we absolutely froze. The goal of the sail boat was to arrive to inca inca, and we still yearn for the day we will arrive to see this mystical beach on the Colombian Atlantic coast near Santa Marta.
